note: Brooks County, TX has no published queryable zoning district service. The only public zoning for its county seat, Falfurrias, is a proposed zoning map offered as a PDF download (no ArcGIS/WFS/OGC service found). ArcGIS search for Brooks County and Falfurrias zoning returned no zoning layers. Regrid holds parcel-level zoning but it is a commercial aggregator, not an official service. Texas counties generally do not administer zoning.
